question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: **A wild goose chase**
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "A futile or hopeless pursuit". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"A wild goose chase"** refers to a futile or hopeless pursuit; a task or activity that is unlikely to succeed or achieve its intended result. (असफल या निरर्थक प्रयास) • **Example:** He went on a wild goose chase trying to find his lost keys in the entire park, only to realize they were at home. • **"Futile or hopeless pursuit"** means engaging in something that has no chance of success or is a waste of effort. (निराशाजनक या व्यर्थ प्रयास) • **Example:** Searching for gold in that abandoned mine is a futile pursuit. • Hence, the idiom "A wild goose chase" aligns with the meaning of "A futile or hopeless pursuit." Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: A fun adventure** (एक मजेदार रोमांच): Refers to an enjoyable or exciting experience. • **Example:** The trek through the mountains turned out to be a fun adventure for the entire group. • **Option 3: A risky task** (एक जोखिम भरा कार्य): Refers to an activity that involves danger or uncertainty. • **Example:** Climbing the steep cliff was a risky task that required careful planning. • **Option 4: A misleading journey** (एक गुमराह करने वाला सफर): Refers to a journey or activity that leads one in the wrong direction or purpose. • **Example:** The detective was sent on a misleading journey by the false clues planted at the crime scene. 41:Ta1b, The correct answer is: **Explicit**.
